smell: The schema-modeled number-input parameter records leave numeric defaults optional (`BoundaryParams.min/max`, `SpinParams.precision/step`) and then reapply domain defaults in the hook body (`minSafeInteger`, `maxSafeInteger`, `0`, `1`). This makes the decoded data less canonical than the runtime data the hook actually uses.
proposedTarget: Move the numeric defaults onto the schemas: `min: S.Finite.pipe(S.optionalKey, SchemaUtils.withKeyDefaults(minSafeInteger))`, `max: ...maxSafeInteger`, `precision: NonNegativePrecision.pipe(S.optionalKey, SchemaUtils.withKeyDefaults(0))`, and `step: S.Finite.pipe(S.optionalKey, SchemaUtils.withKeyDefaults(1))`. In-repo exemplars: `packages/foundation/capability/nlp-processing/src/Graph/AnnotatedTextGraph.ts:274` uses `SchemaUtils.withKeyDefaults`, and `packages/foundation/modeling/lexical/src/Lexical.model.ts:681` uses `SchemaUtils.withConstantDefault(1)`. Keep `parser`, `formatter`, and event callbacks at the React hook boundary.

smell: The exported helper hand-normalizes user text with `Str.trim`, rejects empty strings, converts through `Number`, then collapses invalid/empty values with `O.getOrUndefined`. This is a schema-worthy text-to-finite-number boundary whose absence semantics are currently encoded as `undefined`.
proposedTarget: Introduce a named schema transformation such as `NumberInputNumberFromText` or `NumberInputFiniteFromText` using Effect v4 `S.decodeTo` / `SchemaTransformation.transformOrFail` and `S.Finite` (or repo-available finite string parsing if chosen), then expose an Option-returning parser through `S.decodeUnknownOption(...)` or an `O.Option<number>` helper. If JSX props still require `undefined`, keep that conversion as a thin compatibility wrapper at the component boundary. Verified APIs: `.repos/effect-v4/packages/effect/src/Schema.ts:5408` for `S.decodeTo` and `.repos/effect-v4/packages/effect/src/Schema.ts:1500` for `S.decodeUnknownOption`. In-repo normalization exemplar: `packages/foundation/modeling/schema/src/Color/Color.hex.ts:173` defines `NormalizeHexColor` as a schema transform.

smell: `NumberInputChangeMetadata.error` is modeled as `S.NullOr(NumberInputError)` while `getError` returns `NumberInputError | null` and callers write `error: null` for the no-error case. The absence default is a schema-level invariant, but it is currently spread across return types and call sites.
proposedTarget: Model the field as Option at the schema boundary, for example `error: S.OptionFromNullOr(NumberInputError).pipe(SchemaUtils.withNoneDefault)` if null must be accepted from inputs, or `S.OptionFromOptionalKey(NumberInputError).pipe(SchemaUtils.withNoneDefault)` for decoded objects. Then have `getError` return `O.Option<NumberInputError>` and let JSX/event compatibility wrappers convert only where a consumer contract requires null. Verified APIs: `.repos/effect-v4/packages/effect/src/Schema.ts:8576` for `S.OptionFromNullOr`, `.repos/effect-v4/packages/effect/src/Schema.ts:8668` for `S.OptionFromOptionalKey`, and `packages/foundation/modeling/schema/src/SchemaUtils/withConstructorDefaults.ts:46` for `SchemaUtils.withNoneDefault`. In-repo Option/default exemplar: `packages/foundation/modeling/lexical/src/Lexical.model.ts:688`.

smell: `executed` and `style` are decoded as `Option` fields, but the renderer immediately supplies semantic defaults (`false` for `executed`, default action style for `style`). The defaulted action state is domain data, not only JSX presentation.
proposedTarget: Push the defaults into `NotificationActionFields`: `executed: S.Boolean.pipe(S.optionalKey, SchemaUtils.withKeyDefaults(false))` and `style: ActionStyle.pipe(S.optionalKey, SchemaUtils.withKeyDefaults(ActionStyle.Enum.default))`. If a three-state action is intentionally needed, keep Option but add `SchemaUtils.withNoneDefault` and document that the renderer is the projection boundary. In-repo exemplars: `packages/foundation/modeling/md/src/Md.model.ts:1101` for boolean default helpers and `packages/foundation/capability/nlp-processing/src/Graph/AnnotatedTextGraph.ts:274` for `SchemaUtils.withKeyDefaults`.

smell: `ToastData.variant` is an optional schema key, then rendering resolves `variant ?? toast.data?.variant ?? "default"`. The literal default belongs with the schema-modeled toast data; keeping it only in the renderer means other decoders can observe an under-normalized toast.
proposedTarget: Change `variant` to `ToastVariant.pipe(S.optionalKey, SchemaUtils.withKeyDefaults(ToastVariant.Enum.default))` for schema-created data, then leave only the component prop override branch in the renderer. Verified Effect v4 default API: `.repos/effect-v4/packages/effect/src/Schema.ts:5661` for `S.withDecodingDefaultKey`; repo wrapper exemplar: `packages/foundation/capability/nlp-processing/src/Graph/AnnotatedTextGraph.ts:274`.

smell: `CountryOption.callingCode` is required as `S.String`, but construction from `countries-list` fills missing phone metadata with an empty string via `O.getOrElse(() => "")`. That encodes absence as a string sentinel inside a schema-modeled option record.
proposedTarget: Represent missing phone prefix data as Option, for example `callingCode: S.OptionFromOptionalKey(S.String).pipe(SchemaUtils.withNoneDefault)`, or introduce a named `CountryOptionFromCountriesList` transform that maps an absent/empty phone array to `O.none()` before constructing `CountryOption`. Renderers can then project `O.none` to an empty label only at the combobox display boundary. Verified APIs: `.repos/effect-v4/packages/effect/src/Schema.ts:8668` for `S.OptionFromOptionalKey` and `packages/foundation/modeling/schema/src/SchemaUtils/withConstructorDefaults.ts:46` for `SchemaUtils.withNoneDefault`.

smell: The exported lookup helper returns `CountryOption | undefined` and ends by converting an Option pipeline with `O.getOrUndefined`. Consumers then use optional chaining or empty-string fallbacks, so absence is repeatedly represented outside the Option type.
proposedTarget: Return `O.Option<CountryOption>` from `findCountryOption` (or add `findCountryOptionOption` and keep the existing name as a compatibility wrapper). Callers such as `countryCodeLabel` and phone-input country selection can then explicitly project with `O.match` at JSX boundaries. In-repo style exemplar: `packages/foundation/modeling/lexical/src/Lexical.model.ts:765` uses Option fields as the canonical absence representation.

smell: `normalizeHexColorInput` already delegates to the schema-backed `Color.NormalizeHexColor`, but then converts parse failure to `undefined` through `Result.match`. The schema boundary is present; only the absence surface is leaking out as `undefined`.
proposedTarget: Expose an Option-returning helper backed directly by `S.decodeUnknownOption(Color.NormalizeHexColor)`, and reserve `O.getOrUndefined` for React controlled-input interop if a prop contract requires it. Verified Effect v4 API: `.repos/effect-v4/packages/effect/src/Schema.ts:1500` for `S.decodeUnknownOption`. Existing in-repo target schema: `packages/foundation/modeling/schema/src/Color/Color.hex.ts:173`.

smell: `parsePhoneDraft` normalizes user-entered phone text through third-party formatters, but represents invalid/empty output as the empty-string sentinel with `?? ""`. The exported `PhoneNumberE164` alias is schema-relevant data, while the sentinel is a form-control convenience.
proposedTarget: Introduce a schema-backed E.164 value and draft decoder, for example `PhoneNumberE164` plus `PhoneNumberE164FromDraft` using `S.decodeTo` / `SchemaTransformation.transformOrFail`, returning `O.Option<PhoneNumberE164>` for empty or invalid input. Keep `""` projection only at the controlled input boundary. Verified transform APIs: `.repos/effect-v4/packages/effect/src/Schema.ts:5408` for `S.decodeTo` and `.repos/effect-v4/packages/effect/src/SchemaTransformation.ts` for `transformOrFail`.

smell: The detector sees explicit `Str.trim` / `Str.toLowerCase` protocol normalization before URL safety checks.

exception.reason: This is a trust-boundary URL sanitizer. The SPEC carves out URL/security input hardening from schema-crispening rewrites, and the normalization is part of the guard that blocks unsafe protocols.

smell: The detector sees `DateTime.DateTime | null` and null returns for empty or invalid date input.

exception.reason: The method implements the MUI X date adapter contract, where `null` represents empty or invalid date parsing. Replacing it with Option would break the adapter surface instead of crispening an owned domain model.

smell: The detector sees a component-level `return null` when no chart color configuration needs a generated style tag.

exception.reason: This is the React render-null convention for omitting a subtree, not absence in schema-modeled data. The chart CSS selector sanitizer in the same file is also a trust-boundary concern.

smell: The detector sees hook-level defaults such as `currentOptions.modelId ?? defaultModelId` and SDK option compaction that removes undefined microphone constraints.

exception.reason: These defaults adapt React hook options into the ElevenLabs SDK call shape. The values are not persisted domain records, and preserving SDK optional-object semantics is more important than moving them into local schemas.
exception.boundary: third-party SDK adapter / React hook options
